* '''PC-E1''' (this page): Players Committee card image<ref name="ht1">[https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/eb9f1e88dd679e4fa7860bc7cc8b6032d3476e13/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual6-Light/large/k2so.gif k2so.gif] in the PC's Holotable image repository (the images served at res.starwarsccg.org), commit eb9f1e8 "V6 Remaster Part 2", 22 April 2024.</ref>: “Adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots. Draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. While with Cassian, attrition against opponent is +1 here. If just lost, place out of play; if lost from a site, opponent may not move from there for remainder of turn.” '''What changed:''' the words are the same; the card was remastered (new frame rendering, the image-credit line removed). A version because the change is visible on the card (Bill, 12 November 2026). No errata mark. The card prints the errata mark “none” although this is change 1 in release order: a PC transcription error in the mark (Bill, 12 November 2026: number versions by release order and record the printed mark). * '''PC-E2''' ([[K-2SO (Kay-Tuesso) (Errata 2)]]): Players Committee card image, marked “E1”<ref name="ht2">[https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/9d2c01ed1603f793dc8a0569c99d4b544378da9b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual6-Light/large/k2so.gif k2so.gif] in the PC's Holotable image repository (the images served at res.starwarsccg.org), commit 9d2c01e "Fixing case and making gifs", 30 December 2024.</ref>: “Adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots. If just lost from a site, may ▲ Jyn.” '''What changed:''' “Deploys -1 to Data Vault.” was added; “While with Cassian, attrition against opponent is +1 here.” became “While with Cassian or at Data Vault, your total battle destiny here is +1.”; the last sentence became “If just lost from a site, may ▲ Jyn.”; forfeit 4 became 5. No errata sheet has been found; the PC card data changed on 13 January 2025. The card prints the errata mark “E1” although this is change 2 in release order: a PC transcription error in the mark (Bill, 12 November 2026: number versions by release order and record the printed mark).
